description: This Java class 'AppLabelCache' provides a caching mechanism for application labels based on package names within an Android application. It retrieves application labels using the PackageManager and caches them in an ArrayMap for efficient subsequent lookups.

classes.name: AppLabelCache
classes.description: A cache for storing and retrieving application labels based on package names to improve performance and reduce redundant system calls.

methods.name: AppLabelCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a context.

methods.name: getAppLabel
methods.description: Returns the application label for a given package name, using cache if available; otherwise retrieves and caches it.
